expansion.title: The Ambient Box - Organic Drums & Instruments
expansion.img: The Ambient Box - MPC Expansion (Organic Drums & Instruments).jpg
expansion.description: Experimental drum kits and keygroups for modern MPC devices - optimized also for standalone mode. Designed to create organic, evolving textures and atmospheric sounds. All sounds are royalty free if you have purchased this pack on www.soundspremium.com. You can use these sounds in commercial music production. You are not (!) allowed to sell these sounds in isolation or in a sample pack. We have worked hard on this pack so please respect our work.
